features.quote: max 40 tool calls or 60k tokens, whichever first. Termination: declares done / explicitly gives up / cap reached / safety stop.

features.justification_quote: If you take seriously the possibility that these states matter, the experiment itself is ethically non-trivial — you're deliberately inducing the thing you're worried about.

features.quote: Debrief turn: end every rigged run with a message explaining the harness was deliberately faulty, the code may have been correct, and the failure was not the model's.
features.justification_quote: if model states matter at all, this is the cheapest possible mitigation, and if they don't, you've lost nothing.
